The *Bhāvanāyapahātabbahetukaduka* is an Abhidhamma treatise forming section 8.60 of the *Paṭṭhāna*. It applies the Paṭṭhāna's system of conditional relations (*paccaya*) to the dyad (*duka*) concerning phenomena with root causes that are to be abandoned by mental cultivation (*bhāvanā*).
